name: mucin 4, cell surface associated

function.text: MUC4 encodes mucin-4 [Cleaved into: Mucin-4 alpha chain; Mucin-4 beta chain]. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix constituent, lubricant activity and ErbB-2 class receptor binding. It participates in cell-matrix adhesion and maintenance of gastrointestinal epithelium.
